text:
mike (AE): quick one from FinVault POC — they want tenant pinned to EU but require automatic failover to APAC when EU capacity is saturated.  they also insist on a contractual SLA credit if failover causes cross-border egress. any precedent or pricing approach?

tara (SE): do they want active-active or active-passive? also are they okay with short-term cross-border egress during failover tests?

mike (AE): active-passive is fine. preference is EU-only for data at rest + egress, but acceptable to failover for availability for <5 mins per incident. they asked for a clause that credits them for any egress cost + a small SLA credit if we route outside EU.

hannah (Legal): we don't typically tie SLA credits to routing decisions — credits are latency/availability based. we can draft an exception that limits credit to documented failovers where customer traffic was forwarded outside the pinned region. need exact thresholds (duration, recurrence) and whether they want reporting/audit logs. also need subprocessor disclosure for APAC.

oliver (Infra): technically: we have per-tenant region affinity with sticky routing. fallback is governed by routing_policy and capacity tiers. default fallback sequence: eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> ap-southeast-1. cross-border egress occurs only when the fallback target is outside the pinned region. for private/dedicated we can avoid third-party APAC subprocessors.

sam (Sales Eng): pricing options: 1) EU reserved capacity (recommended) — reduces chance of failover and keeps egress internal. 2) hot-standby in APAC + lower per-token failover fee. 3) one-time egress credit allowance in contract + runbook conditions. ballpark: reserved pool adds ~30-45% to the list price depending on QPS; egress credit can be a capped monthly allowance (e.g., €X per month) rather than open-ended SLA credit.

mike (AE): Hannah, can you draft a short exception template we can show the buyer? Also need list of APAC subprocessors we would hit if fallback triggers.

hannah (Legal): I can draft. mike — give me: (a) exact fallback targets you want covered, (b) max acceptable # of failovers/month, (c) whether they require audit logs delivered to S3 or via Console.

mike (AE): forwarding details from FinVault: fallback targets should be limited to ap-southeast-1 only, max 3 failovers/month, audit logs to be delivered to their S3. they might ask for BYOK for keys.

oliver (Infra): noted — if BYOK required and audit to customer's S3, we can provide Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering. public-hosted fallback to APAC will use our partner cloud provider there. subprocessors likely: "apac-cp-cloud" and "thirdparty-logging-cdn". if they need subproc removal, require Dedicated/Private.

sam (Sales Eng): for the quote, i'll draft two line items: (A) EU reserved pool (monthly commit) + (B) contingency egress credit cap + (C) optional Dedicated plan for BYOK/subproc exclusion.

mike (AE): thanks. tara — can you run an operational test plan we can share? simple runbook + how we'll count/measure failovers for contract triggers.

tara (SE): yes. quick runbook skeleton below — will expand in Confluence:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  prefer_region: eu-west-1
  fallback: ap-southeast-1
  failover_threshold: 95%
  failover_duration_window: 300s
  audit_delivery: s3://finvault-audit-bucket
```

tara (SE): measurement notes: we'll log route change events with request ids + timestamps; honest failover counted when >50% of tenant requests in a 1min window are served from fallback region.

hannah (Legal): that threshold is actionable. i'll draft exception language referencing the YAML metrics. also will add a clause limiting subprocessor disclosure and a remediation timeline.

mike (AE): great. Sam — once you have the two-line pricing I can share the draft contract.

sam (Sales Eng): will do today. estimating EU reserved monthly + 2TB egress cap for credit — i'll send numbers.

deploy-bot: autoscaler-test: EU pool scaled to 95% at 2029-10-11T14:12:05Z, fallback route triggered to ap-southeast-1 for 42s (simulated). logs pushed to s3://redwood-ci/fallback-tests/5523187600.log :white_check_mark:

mike (AE): perfect — thanks team. i'll bundle legal template + pricing and loop in the buyer for sign-off.
